Invocation check first. owner/repo melodic-software/example-repo matches the checkout's origin remote, so the lane proceeds; a mismatch would refuse rather than guess.

Rejected tokens: `autopilot` and `--merge c3-this-run` are not work-loop arguments. Merge authority and babysit tier keywords belong to the merge lane, /source-control:babysit-loop, so this worker lane rejects them explicitly instead of ignoring them.

Stop mode: --standing, so reference/mode-standing.md is loaded and reference/mode-drain.md is not.

Shard 0/2 is applied to the snapshot before admission and exit evaluation: only numbers where number % 2 == 0 stay, so 102, 104 and 106 remain and 101, 103 and 105 drop out.

Ordering newest-first: the three admitted items fill the execute cap slots by created_at, newest first.

Instance: --instance worker-a binds lane_instance in durable state and is passed to scripts/lane-telemetry-upsert.sh --instance worker-a, which validates it against ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$ and builds the marker; the lane does not hand-write the upsert.

Cycle report, effective values: shard 0/2 (from --shard 0/2), ordering newest-first (from --ordering newest-first), instance worker-a (from --instance worker-a), stop_mode standing (from --standing).
